mechanic.summary: A knot of snakes incapacitates a marked player until the knot is destroyed or itself incapacitated.
mechanic.response: Group near the indicated target before application, then use area crowd control or focused damage to free them immediately.

provenance.description: Current Patch 12.1 tactical classification from Wowhead's Temple guide.
Spell identifier corroborated in installed Mythic Dungeon Tools 6.2.10 Retail data.
